{"evidence":[{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Beaux-Arts architecture ( ; ] ) expresses the academic neoclassical architectural style taught at the \"École des Beaux-Arts\" in Paris.","title":"Beaux-Arts architecture"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" The \"style\" \"Beaux Arts\" is the cumulative product of two-and-a-half centuries of instruction under the authority, first, of the \"Académie royale d'architecture\" (1671–1793), then, following the French Revolution of the late 18th century, of the Architecture section of the \"Académie des Beaux-Arts\" (1795– ).","title":"Beaux-Arts architecture"},{"sentence_id":2,"text":" The organization under the \"Ancien Régime\" of the competition for the \"Grand Prix de Rome\" in architecture, offering a chance to study in Rome, imprinted its codes and aesthetic on the course of instruction, which culminated during the Second Empire (1852–1870) and the Third Republic that followed.","title":"Beaux-Arts architecture"},{"sentence_id":3,"text":" The style of instruction that produced Beaux-Arts architecture continued without major interruption until 1968.","title":"Beaux-Arts architecture"},{"sentence_id":0,"text":"Peggy Adam (born 1974) is a French comic book artist and illustrator.","title":"Peggy Adam"},{"sentence_id":1,"text":" She studied at the Ecole des Beaux-Arts in Saint-Étienne, at the OCAD University in Toronto, and at the ESI (Ecole Supérieure de l'Image) in Angoulême.","title":"Peggy Adam"}],"peer_messages":[],"previous_answer":null,"question":"Where is the historic meeting venue built in a style taught at the Ecole des Beaux-Arts?"}
